rationale: Both catch the orphaned AMD footnote/missing table checkmark, but X also gestures (in its nits) at the mkdocs --strict build failure that drove two CHANGES_REQUESTED reviews and references the MiniMax-H3-MUSA.md precedent for a separate ROCm file, both real ground-truth threads Y misses entirely.
